pages.title: Bruder Scania Super 560R Cattle Transportation Truck With Cattle
pages.description: The Bruder 03548 Scania Super 560R animal transport truck is the successor of the Bruder 03549 Scania R. Available in store or online now.
pages.ld_description:
Introducing the Bruder 1:16 Scania Super 560R Cattle Transportation Truck with Cattle . The Bruder 03548 Scania Super 560R animal transport truck is the successor of the Bruder 03549 Scania R. The animal transport truck has the latest Scania Super 560R cabin which has been copied in detail from the real Scania trucks. The cabin doors can really open so that play figures can also be placed in the cabin. And it is even better for children to imagine that they are driving the toy truck themselves. 

The livestock transport superstructure of the truck is a loading bridge. In other words it is removable from the frame of the truck and can therefore be exchanged for another truck or separate trailer. For example, the UPS trucks from Bruder (3581 and 2828) are also suitable for transporting this livestock transport container. The container also has legs, so you can easily maneuver the truck underneath. The Bruder Scania Super 560R is equipped with real rubber wheels with a street profile. For fun, the livestock container has a fold-out tailgate so that the toy animals can easily get in and out of the wagon. There are also doors on the side, which makes it even more realistic to play with this Bruder truck.
